args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Action taken: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback, all three regions are serving v2.3.0, health checks are passing, and the error rate has dropped to ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression is still under investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Rollback**: checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. I rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production (no change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 had a prior healthy production track record).
2. **Verification**: Post-rollback status shows all regions on v2.3.0, health checks passing, and error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident "checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0" with a full description of the failure and remediation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

The root cause of the v2.3.1 regression remains to be investigated by the on-call engineer.
